This site collects the hands-on and take-home exercises completed for **ISSS626:
Geospatial Analytics and Applications**, part of the Master of IT in Business
programme at Singapore Management University.

Each exercise is written up as a reproducible R notebook — the code, its output, and
a short reflection on what the data actually showed, including the places where
real-world datasets didn't match the reference material exactly and had to be worked
around.

## Author

**Jedidiah Asaf Tallulembang**
Singapore Management University

## Built with

- [Quarto](https://quarto.org) for the site and notebook rendering
- [sf](https://r-spatial.github.io/sf/), [tmap](https://r-tmap.github.io/tmap/), and
  the [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org/) for the analysis itself
- Deployed on [Vercel](https://vercel.com), source on
  [GitHub](https://github.com/jediasaf/isss626-coursework)
